questions.question: Who is currently 4th from top of the Premier League table today, Tuesday, 24th Nov 2026?

questions.question: Brentford won at home last night (Monday); who did they beat?
questions.clue: A Merseyside club famously nicknamed "The Toffees."
questions.funFact: The defeat spoiled manager David Moyes' milestone 593rd match in charge of the club, the most in their history.

questions.question: What was the score?
questions.clue: A four-goal clean-sheet victory for the hosts.
questions.funFact: Keane Lewis-Potter scored a first-half brace before second-half goals from Vitaly Janelt and Fábio Carvalho sealed the rout at the Gtech Community Stadium.

questions.question: Which Everton player was sent off?
questions.clue: Everton's experienced English centre-back and team captain.
questions.funFact: He received a straight red card in the 40th minute, leaving his side to play with ten men for over half the match.

questions.question: On this day in football history, 24th November 2024, Manchester United appointed a new manager; whom?
questions.clue: A Portuguese tactician who won two Primeira Liga titles with Sporting CP before moving to Old Trafford.
questions.funFact: He took charge of his first match on that date—a 1–1 Premier League draw away at Ipswich Town—after leaving Sporting CP.

questions.question: What nationality is Manchester City midfielder Antoine Semenyo?
questions.clue: He plays for the West African national team famously nicknamed "The Black Stars."
questions.funFact: Born in London, he qualified through his heritage and made his senior international debut for his country in June 2022 before representing them at the FIFA World Cup.

questions.question: What shirt number does Antoine Semenyo wear for City?
questions.clue: An even double-digit number famously worn previously at the Etihad by club legend Yaya Touré.
questions.funFact: He chose the number upon joining Manchester City in January 2026 because it was his very first squad number at Bristol City, and his usual number 24 was already taken by Joško Gvardiol.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has Antoine Semenyo won?
questions.clue: The digit representing none at all.
questions.funFact: Having joined Manchester City midway through the 2025–26 campaign after three years at Bournemouth, he is still chasing his first English top-flight crown.

questions.question: Who is Arsenal's top scorer so far this season?
questions.clue: The Norwegian international who wears the captain's armband for Arsenal.
questions.funFact: The inspirational playmaker leads the Gunners' scoring charts while orchestrating their attack from midfield.

questions.question: What is the seating capacity of Old Trafford?
questions.clue: A five-digit number sitting exactly 10,000 above 64,158.
questions.funFact: Nicknamed "The Theatre of Dreams," it is the largest club football stadium in the United Kingdom and the second-largest overall behind Wembley.
